description:
Runs Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and other terminal coding agents together on one mission.

Runner is a native desktop application where terminal agents work together. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity CLI, Copilot CLI and pi can take the same task in one mission, and each agent keeps its own TUI in a real terminal while the lead brings the decisions back to you. Everything in Runner is also a `runner` command: missions, crews, roles, projects, chats, sessions and messages are all addressable from the command line, with `runnerd` as the background service. Agents run natively on Windows without WSL, and PowerShell 7 is optional. Status: alpha, actively shipping. Native builds target macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows (x64) on Windows 10 version 1809 or later; Intel Macs, Windows ARM64 and Linux are not supported. The installer, the application and the CLI sidecars are Authenticode-signed with a Certum open-source certificate issued to Open Source Developer Yicheng Wang.
Runner 0.16.6 is a feature release for macOS and Windows on top of 0.16.5.
New
- An Active view in the sidebar. The new list-filter button beside Search switches the sidebar between Projects and Active, and Runner remembers your choice. Active gathers running chats, terminals and missions from every project, plus anything with unread output or an error, in Chats, Missions and Terminals groups with what needs you at the top. Each tab is one row, as in Projects; selecting a row opens its tab on the pane that needs attention, and ⌘1–9 follow the visible list. Projects keeps its organization and drag and drop unchanged. (#887)
- A simpler usage footer. The sidebar footer now shows weekly usage for Codex and Claude only; select it to open Usage with every provider, including Antigravity. (#887)
Bug fixes
- Paused missions no longer count as running on the Crews page. A mission whose sessions had all stopped, for example after its slots were stopped or Runner's background service restarted, kept showing as running and live. The crew list and crew cards now count only missions with a live session, and a paused mission is labelled paused. (#948)
